att2.tutorial.advancement.title: Advancement Tutorial
att2.tutorial.advancement.title.tip: Click here to view the advancement tutorial
att2.tutorial.advancement.detail: The advancement page allows players to view various achievements. Completing achievements grants rewards such as experience and exploration points.
att2.tutorial.bank.title: Bank Information
att2.tutorial.bank.title.tip: Click here to view bank information
att2.tutorial.bank.detail: Players can store Chronotons in banks located in various cities/villages. Right-click the sign in the bank window to deposit or withdraw Chronotons.
att2.tutorial.currency.title: Currency Information
att2.tutorial.currency.title.tip: Click here to view currency information
att2.tutorial.currency.detail: There are many currencies in the game, obtainable through various means. They are usually automatically stored when approached or picked up. Players can view related currencies in the <Currency Information> page of the <Book of Awakening>.
att2.tutorial.death.title: Death Information
att2.tutorial.death.title.tip: Click here to view death information
att2.tutorial.death.detail: Upon death, players lose some Chronotons and saturation. The higher the game difficulty, the greater the death penalty.
att2.tutorial.consciousness.title: Book of Awakening Information
att2.tutorial.consciousness.title.tip: Click here to view Book of Awakening information
att2.tutorial.consciousness.detail:
The <Book of Awakening> is an important guide. Players can hold it, long-press right-click, or press the G key to open the menu.
The <Book of Awakening> contains various basic game functions and introductions, as well as game settings.
att2.tutorial.quest_assistant.title: Quest Assistant Information
att2.tutorial.quest_assistant.title.tip: Click here to view Quest Assistant information
att2.tutorial.quest_assistant.detail: Players can view the progress of main/side/daily quests in the <Book of Awakening> and get hints, which can help quickly solve quest challenges.
att2.tutorial.keys.title: Key and Lock Information
att2.tutorial.keys.title.tip: Click here to view key and lock information
att2.tutorial.keys.detail: Players encounter various keys during main/side quests. Hold a key and right-click the corresponding lock to open the door.
att2.tutorial.recycle.title: Recycling Merchant
att2.tutorial.recycle.title.tip: Click here to view Recycling Merchant information
att2.tutorial.recycle.detail: Unwanted items can be sold to the Recycling Merchant. The more items sold, the higher the recycling price offered.
att2.tutorial.rarity.title: Item Rarity Information
att2.tutorial.rarity.title.tip: Click here to view item rarity information
att2.tutorial.rarity.detail: There are many rarities: quest items, common, uncommon, rare, epic, exquisite, legendary, ultimate, mythical, etc. Players can quickly identify rarities by the glow and particle color, and can disable particle/glow display in the <Book of Awakening>.
att2.tutorial.rune_room.title: Rune Room Information
att2.tutorial.rune_room.title.tip: Click here to view Rune Room information
att2.tutorial.rune_room.detail:
Players can perform synthesis/grinding in the Rune Room.
Left-click the <Rune Core> in the center to switch between synthesis/grinding.
Right-click the <Rune Core> to view recipes. The synthesis container can be used to craft special items from rune materials/other items.
After crafting runes, place them on the display stand in the Rune Room to activate them.
att2.tutorial.rune_ore.title: Rune Ore and Material Information
att2.tutorial.rune_ore.title.tip: Click here to view Rune Ore and Material information
att2.tutorial.rune_ore.detail:
Players can find various rune ores in Sylberland. Collected ores can be exchanged with NPCs for rune powder.
Rune materials from loot can be used in rune recipes.
att2.tutorial.ender_chest.title: Ender Chest Information
att2.tutorial.ender_chest.title.tip: Click here to view Ender Chest information
att2.tutorial.ender_chest.detail:
Ender Chests store many items, but players cannot view the contents in real time.
Left-click to release stored items.
Right-click to enter absorption mode, continuously sucking up nearby items.
The more items absorbed/released, the longer the cooldown. However, players can spend Chronotons to instantly complete the cooldown.
att2.tutorial.stock.title: Dimensional Pocket Information
att2.tutorial.stock.title.tip: Click here to view Dimensional Pocket information
att2.tutorial.stock.detail:
Players need to hold the <Book of Awakening>, sneak, and right-click to open the <Dimensional Pocket>, which holds many items.
Each time/space gem obtained unlocks an additional storage slot.
Buttons in the <Dimensional Pocket> allow quick page-turning, item discarding, and item pickup.
att2.tutorial.spell.title: Dahäl Spell Information
att2.tutorial.spell.title.tip: Click here to view Dahäl Spell information
att2.tutorial.spell.detail:
Throwing a Dahäl spellbook/casting tool switches its form.
Selecting a spell level in the spellbook automatically switches to caster form. Right-click while holding the caster tool to cast the spell.
Click spell names in the book to view corresponding spell data.
att2.tutorial.mount.title: Mount Information
att2.tutorial.mount.title.tip: Click here to view Mount information
att2.tutorial.mount.detail: Players can buy mounts from horse keepers in some cities. Mounts generally increase movement speed. Click the <Whistle> in the <Book of Awakening> to store/summon a mount.
att2.tutorial.rune_enchantment.title: Rune Enchantment Information
att2.tutorial.rune_enchantment.title.tip: Click here to view Rune Enchantment information
att2.tutorial.rune_enchantment.detail:
Players can perform special enchantments on equipment in the enchantment room in Ryliath.
Enchantments usually cost a large amount of Chaos Scales and rune powder.
att2.tutorial.exploration.title: Exploration Information
att2.tutorial.exploration.title.tip: Click here to view Exploration information
att2.tutorial.exploration.detail: Loot can be obtained from chests, glimmers, buried treasures, pots, rune ores, etc. These methods quickly improve player abilities.
att2.tutorial.attribute.title: Player Attribute Information
att2.tutorial.attribute.title.tip: Click here to view Player Attribute information
att2.tutorial.attribute.detail:
Players gain ability points upon leveling up. These can be spent in the player attribute page of the <Book of Awakening> to improve basic attributes. Basic attribute values can also be viewed there.
Wearing equipment, drinking potions, and body temperature affect current attributes.
All basic attributes can be reset at the Ability Master in Ryliath.
att2.tutorial.dailyquest.title: Daily Quest Information
att2.tutorial.dailyquest.title.tip: Click here to view Daily Quest information
att2.tutorial.dailyquest.detail:
Players can view/accept daily quests at daily quest boards in cities/villages.
Daily quests are time-limited; consider whether you can complete them within the time limit.
att2.tutorial.dialog.title: NPC Dialogue Information
att2.tutorial.dialog.title.tip: Click here to view NPC Dialogue information
att2.tutorial.dialog.detail:
Right-click to talk to NPCs. NPCs with a red exclamation mark (<!>) usually need help; players can accept side quests from them.
Different dialogue options may affect the outcome.
att2.tutorial.shop.title: Shop Information
att2.tutorial.shop.title.tip: Click here to view Shop information
att2.tutorial.shop.detail:
Players can trade with merchants in various cities, usually spending Chronotons or Chaos Scales.
Most items have discounts; current reputation affects the discount.
att2.tutorial.enemy.title: Enemy Information
att2.tutorial.enemy.title.tip: Click here to view Enemy information
att2.tutorial.enemy.detail:
Enemies have a base level. Players can determine the enemy's level by the icon above them or the color of their health bar.
Enemies emitting light are super/ultimate elite enemies.
Enemies with special symbols are aberrant elite enemies.
att2.tutorial.elytra_race.title: Pelzion Elytra Race Information
att2.tutorial.elytra_race.title.tip: Click here to view Pelzion Elytra Race information
att2.tutorial.elytra_race.detail:
In various dimensions, there are vents buried under dirt or frozen. After clearing them, players can use Pelzion (elytra) to fly.
During the race, there are particle rings. Press the spacebar when passing through them to accelerate. Different rings have different acceleration effects.
Completing the race rewards a large amount of loot.
att2.tutorial.horse_race.title: Sylberländ Steeplechase
att2.tutorial.horse_race.title.tip: Click here to view Sylberländ Steeplechase information
att2.tutorial.horse_race.detail:
After completing certain daily quests in each city/village of Sylberland, the Sylberländ Steeplechase race quest appears. Participate in a horse race across Sylberland against other challengers.
During the race, there are usually quest items and special mechanisms. Achieving a good result allows you to accept the next race at daily quest boards in other cities.
att2.tutorial.fire.title: Flame Resonance Information
att2.tutorial.fire.title.tip: Click here to view Flame Resonance information
att2.tutorial.fire.detail: Your fire spells have been enhanced and can melt thin ice walls.
att2.tutorial.earthquake.title: Seismic Resonance Information
att2.tutorial.earthquake.title.tip: Click here to view Seismic Resonance information
att2.tutorial.earthquake.detail: Your earthquake spell has been enhanced and can shatter some unstable-looking blocks.
att2.tutorial.deposit.title: Quest Turn-in Information
att2.tutorial.deposit.title.tip: Click here to view Quest Turn-in information
att2.tutorial.deposit.detail: Some quests require turning in specific quest items, usually by standing on a gold pressure plate.
att2.tutorial.waypoint.title: Teleportation Array Information
att2.tutorial.waypoint.title.tip: Click here to view Teleportation Array information
att2.tutorial.waypoint.detail: Teleportation arrays are scattered across Sylberland, allowing fast travel between arrays, but they must be unlocked first.
